Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: National Identification Card (CNI) is a multifunctional electronic smart card integrated with SNIAC (National System for Civil Identification and Authentication), PKI infrastructure, and the CMDCV (Mobile Digital Key). The system provides Single Sign On across government services and is integrated with PDEX data exchange layer. NOSi states goal to reach 100% resident adoption.

Comments: Electronic Passport (PEC) launched in Praia in 2016, meeting international requirements. Consular Portal (launched 2020) allows diaspora to apply for passports and ID cards online, integrated with SNIAC. Passport system connected through NOSi's interoperability infrastructure.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Cape Verde is Africa's data protection pioneer: Data Protection Law (Law 133/V/2001, amended 2013 and 2021). Law of Administrative Modernization updated to prioritize digital transactions. Law of System of Access and Reuse of Documents (2022). Legislative Decree No. 5/2020 on Mobile Digital Key. These collectively enable cross-government data sharing with regulatory framework.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: PDEX (Platform for Data Exchange) is an operational interoperability/service bus platform developed and managed by NOSi since 2018. Per World Bank GovTech Maturity Index (2023): "In 2018, Cabo Verde launched the NOSI Cloud, a shared national cloud platform... together with the Data Exchange Platform (PDEX), which is a service bus extensively used by both central and local governments." Additional World Bank financing (2025) includes strengthening PDEX as a key activity. The system is described as partially operational; integration across all systems is ongoing.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: NOSi is a government-owned entity (established 1998) hosting data in national data centers (NOSI Cloud). PKI infrastructure is nationally owned. Government Cloud platform managed by NOSi. Data Protection Law (2001, amended 2013/2021) requires prior authorization for international data transfers. Strong controls exist and enforced through national infrastructure.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: PDEX is described as "extensively used by both central and local governments." NOSi provides services to municipalities. The National Governance Framework ToR (2025) explicitly includes embassies and consulates in the scope. However, full participation across all islands/municipalities is unclear; some fragmentation noted.
